0.0: I fear many of the students here have charged into the fields, despite my warnings. My pupils can be a tad bit overzealous
0.1: Do humans have #bMandrakies#k to worry about? We typically harvest them from the #bMandraky Field#k behind our academy for use in numerous tinctures.
0.2: They're useful, but they can be a little unruly. Especially when the students go traipsing about their territory.
0.3: You will not be able to find them with traditional methods. The enchantments around the Academy are quite powerful. Go out, and take #bCootie#k with you.

yes.0: Please find the students.\r\n#b(Talk to Cootie.)#k

no.0: I've come to expect disappointment from humans.

1.0: #i4033830#\r\nThis #bDirectional Sonar#k should help us find those children. With my vast cultural knowledge and amazing intellect, and your... whatever you're bringing to the table, we should find those students no problem!

yes.0: Away, fellow detective!\r\n(Meet Cootie in the #b#m101073000##k.)
